title: A penny doubled for 30 days vs $1 million
caption:
A penny that doubles every day for 30 days:
Day 10: $5.12
Day 20: $5,243
Day 30: $5.37 million.
That's compounding. The last days do most of the work.
comment: Be honest: would you have picked the million? 👇

scenes.say: A million dollars today... or a penny that doubles every day for thirty days?
Day ten. Five dollars and twelve cents.
Day twenty. About five thousand dollars.
Day thirty. Over five point three million dollars.
That's compounding. The last days do most of the work.
